senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. זבד)to entertain liberally.—Denom. זְבוּל.
(cmp. זבח) to offer to idols, make merry with idolatrous ceremonies.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18b:9">Ab. Zar. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>שמְזַבְּלִין שם וכ׳</he> because they have there (in their theatres) idolatrous entertainments; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 2:5">Tosef. ib. II, 5</cite> (ed. Zuck. <he>מזבחין</he>). Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵇ bot. if one sees people <he>מז׳ לע״ז</he> engaged in idolatrous services; a. fr.
